title: Mobility management based network slice admission control

entities.name: Network Slice Admission Control
entities.description: Procedure performed by AMF to monitor and control the number of registered UEs per network slice subject to NSAC.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Information element containing the network slices allowed for the UE.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Information element containing the network slices rejected for the UE.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message used to accept UE registration and provide allowed/rejected NSSAI.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REJECT
entities.description: NAS message used to reject UE registration when all requested S-NSSAIs are rejected.

entities.name: Generic UE Configuration Update Procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to update UE configuration including allowed/rejected NSSAI.

entities.name: Network-initiated De-registration Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network to de-register UE when all S-NSSAIs are rejected.

entities.name: DEREGISTRATION REQUEST
entities.description: NAS message used in network-initiated de-registration procedure.

entities.name: EAC Mode Activated
entities.description: Condition where EAC mode is activated for an S-NSSAI when UE count reaches threshold.

entities.name: EAC Mode Deactivated
entities.description: Condition where EAC mode is deactivated for an S-NSSAI.

entities.name: Emergency PDU Session Active
entities.description: Condition where UE has emergency PDU session established or is establishing one.

entities.name: Maximum UEs Reached
entities.description: Property indicating that maximum number of UEs has been reached for S-NSSAI.

relations.description: Network slice admission control requires EAC mode to be activated for pre-allocation control.
Network slice admission control requires EAC mode to be deactivated for post-allocation control.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains Allowed NSSAI IE.
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains Rejected NSSAI IE.
REGISTRATION REJECT message contains Rejected NSSAI IE.
Maximum UEs reached condition establishes REGISTRATION REJECT message transmission.
Maximum UEs reached condition establishes Generic UE Configuration Update Procedure.
Maximum UEs reached condition establishes Network-initiated De-registration Procedure.
DEREGISTRATION REQUEST message contains Rejected NSSAI IE.
Emergency session condition guards execution of Generic UE Configuration Update instead of de-registration.
